sentences.text: Protopelicanus cuvierii is a fossil waterbird whose exact classification remains uncertain.
Michel Brunet suggested in 1970 that the lectotype femur belonged to a pelican.
Georges Cuvier briefly described the fossil in 1822, but Ludwig Reichenbach formally named it in 1852.
The fossil was found in Late Eocene deposits in Montmartre, France.
The genus is classified within the order Pelecaniformes.
The animal lived between 37.71 and 33.9 million years ago during the Priabonian stage.
Colin Harrison proposed in 1979 that the fossil belonged to the Sulidae, while Storrs Olson suggested in 1995 it might be a pelagornithid.
